preservationRules: Do not revive historical Mass ownership.
Do not replace current modular data/runtime owners with prototype monolith ownership.
Extract/reproduce donor presentation exactly over modular owners.
Do not certify a substitute because it has the same conceptual feature.
Reduced-motion behavior may suppress non-essential motion but must preserve the donor's information hierarchy.
One state must still map to one visible surface.
requiredAcceptance: Donor/current side-by-side captures at 390x844 for Home, PRAY hub, representative prayer reader, Rosary, Angelus, Stations, Adoration/Benediction, Confession, Learn, Calendar and Settings.
Exact transition trigger/content/timing matrix from donor to modular owner.
Exact loader state matrix from donor to modular owner.
Exact rail state/icon/visibility/cue matrix from donor to modular owner.
No Mass ownership regression and no obsolete PrayerBook fallback.
App release gate may return to FINAL_APP_READY only when all findings are CLOSED.
